name: Anzen Finance
rootCause: Anzen Finance, the issuer of RWA stablecoins, announced on the X platform that on July 30, due to an error in the Blast vault contract, a white hat hacker exploited the vault to steal 500,000 USDz. The white hat returned $450,000 in a timely manner and received a $50,000 bounty as a reward.
